meta.name: meshy-3d-agent
meta.description: Generate 3D models, textures, images, rig characters, animate them, and prepare for 3D printing using the Meshy AI API. Handles API key detection, task creation, polling, downloading, and full 3D print pipeline with slicer integration. Use when the user asks to create 3D models, convert text/images to 3D, texture models, rig or animate characters, 3D print a model, or interact with the Meshy API.

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成3D模型，添加纹理、骨骼和动画，并准备3D打印。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速将创意转化为3D模型并用于打印或动画。
